Name: (CP) Monkey D. Luffy
Author: Wh3el0fT1me
Description: Just a simple content patch in which I replace the original farmer shirt with that of Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece. This is my first mod, and so it is not very good. I am hoping to be able to create the whole outfit later on, but it took a number of hours just to get this far... So it may take some time. I had an idea of potentially adding a devil fruit weapon that would extend the player's arms... (it would act like a dagger and give the player the gum gum bullet and gatling ability) But since it took hours just to get an image to work, I don't think I can do that.

Manifest.Name: Monkey D Luffy (CP)
Manifest.Description: Adds a Luffy shirt skin to the farmer (shirt only so far... hoping to add more) inspired by One Piece
